scope: Rename a project in its existing settings
assumptions: Saving is tested with a local fixture without external writes

system.authority: Existing settings page and its FormField/Button
system.tokenSource: Project theme; the skill's example tokens do not replace it
system.expression: Preserve the brand and settings presentation
system.rationale: One infrequent action, a persistent label, and an explicit outcome

tasks.scenario: Change the project name and recover from a save failure
tasks.outcome: The heading and field show the saved name
tasks.recovery: Preserve the entered name on failure, show the reason, and allow retry

components.responsive: Label above the field; long values remain accessible inside the input

actions.label: Project name
actions.recovery: Correct the draft or cancel editing before submission

components.responsive: The button remains visible and its label wraps without losing text

actions.label: Save changes
actions.outcome: The new name is saved after a confirmed response and the outcome is announced
actions.recovery: Preserve the draft on failure, end pending, and allow retry

checks.scenario: Edit the name, trigger fixture failure, and retry; preserve the draft and report a truthful result
Tab to the field and submit; Enter submits, focus is visible, and assistive technology can access the result
Check a long name at 320 and 1440, pending/error states, and 200% text without overlap
